tagline.zh-CN: 提炼论文核心贡献、实验证据与局限性，3 分钟看懂新研究值不值得精读。
tagline.en: Distills research papers into core claims, evidence, and limitations in a 3-minute read.

description.zh-CN: 面向 AI、系统与工程研究者的论文速读与追踪助手。支持单篇 PDF/链接深度拆解、多篇对比矩阵，以及结合 RSS / Notion 建立个人文献卡片。
description.en: A research paper triage and synthesis partner for AI and systems engineers. Breaks down papers into structured cards, builds side-by-side comparison matrices, and optionally saves digests to Notion.
